journey.name: Health Connect
journey.description: Connect Health Connect in Settings, finish a workout and find it in Health Connect, then disconnect. Run on a phone in portrait on Android 14 or later, where Health Connect is part of the system; the emulator's Health Connect must be open once before (Settings > Security and privacy > Health Connect). Where a step cannot be verified without the Health Connect app, note it as not checked.

actions.action: Tap the "Settings" button on the Timer tab
Scroll to "Your data" and verify that it shows a "Health Connect" switch, off, saying "Save finished workouts and Lift sessions there too"
Verify that Health Connect's permission sheet opens, asking to write exercise and total calories burned, with Interval's privacy policy linked
Tap the privacy policy link and verify that Interval's "Privacy" page opens, with a "Health Connect" section; go back to the sheet
Verify that the "Health Connect" switch is on and says "Finished workouts and Lift sessions are saved there"
Tap "Start workout", skip to the first rest with "Skip to next interval" twice, tap "End workout" and confirm

Open Health Connect (Settings > Security and privacy > Health Connect > Data and access > Exercise) and verify that an Interval entry of high intensity interval training is listed for today, with segments
Return to Interval, tap "Done", then the "Settings" button
Tap the "Health Connect" switch and verify that it is off
Open Health Connect's app permissions and verify that Interval has no permissions left
Tap the "Settings" button on the Timer tab, then "About Interval" under "About", then "Privacy", and verify that the policy page shows
